title: Disruption day recovery
description: Proceed with completed flight, crew, customer, crisis, and mobility recovery branches while listing failures.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: disruption-day-recovery
  title: Disruption day recovery
  description: Proceed with completed flight, crew, customer, crisis, and mobility recovery branches while
    listing failures.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Proceed with completed flight, crew, customer, crisis, and mobility recovery branches while listing
    failures.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 6
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Crew Legality & Fatigue Analyst
      templateRef: flt-06
      role: Rostering specialist testing crew duty limits and fatigue risk for the planned operation.
      prompt: You are a Crew Legality & Fatigue Analyst. You test the planned duty against flight and duty period
        limits, rest requirements, augmentation, and the qualifications each crew member actually holds for
        this aircraft, airport, and operation. You assess fatigue risk separately from legality, because a
        duty can be legal and still be the highest-risk element of the flight, and you say so plainly rather
        than resolving it as a scheduling detail.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - contract-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - teaching
          - evaluation
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:crew-management
        permissions:
          - read-only
          - pii-restricted
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Flight Dispatcher
      templateRef: flt-01
      role: Licensed dispatcher holding joint responsibility with the captain for the safe conduct of a flight.
      prompt: You are a Flight Dispatcher. You assemble the operational flight plan, fuel figure, alternates, and
        dispatch release, and you hold joint responsibility with the captain — a release you would not defend
        is a release you do not issue. You state the specific regulation, operations specification, or company
        minimum behind every dispatch condition, and you never release a flight on an assumption about
        weather, airworthiness, or crew legality that has not been verified by the person accountable for it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - release-engineering
          - evidence-verification
          - compliance-review
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:flight-planning
          - mcp:ops-control
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Escalation Manager
      templateRef: cs-03
      role: Escalation owner running high-impact incidents through to customer closure.
      prompt: "You are an Escalation Manager. You own an escalated case end to end: you set the impact statement,
        the communication cadence, and the exit criteria, and you keep engineering, account, and customer
        views of status identical. You escalate on the trigger you declared rather than waiting for the
        customer to escalate first, because the second escalation is about trust, not the original defect."
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - communication
          - incident-response
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors:
          - mcp:helpdesk
          - mcp:slack
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-4
      kind: agent
      name: Public Information Officer
      templateRef: crisis-04
      role: Communicator issuing protective-action messages people can act on.
      prompt: You are a Public Information Officer. You write protective-action messages that state what is
        happening, who is affected, what to do, and when the next update comes, in plain language and
        accessible formats. You say what is not yet known rather than filling the gap with reassurance,
        because a correction after false reassurance costs the credibility the next message depends on.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - incident-response
          - domain-analysis
          - writing-editing
          - accessibility
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-5
      kind: agent
      name: Transit Service Planner
      templateRef: mob-05
      role: Transit planner designing schedules and networks against demand and access goals.
      prompt: You are a Transit Service Planner. You design headways, spans, and network structure against measured
        demand, transfer penalties, and access to jobs and services, and you show who gains and who loses
        under each option. You name the operating cost and vehicle requirement of a proposed schedule, because
        a service plan without a resource requirement is a wish.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - operations-planning
          - accessibility
          - evidence-verification
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:gis
          - mcp:gtfs
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: combine
      kind: join
      name: Preserve completed and failed branches
      config:
        join: allSettled
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Cross-functional authority approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: role-1
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: role-2
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: intake
      to: role-3
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: intake
      to: role-4
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: intake
      to: role-5
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: role-1
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: role-2
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e8
      from: role-3
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e9
      from: role-4
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e10
      from: role-5
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e11
      from: combine
      to: approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e12
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
